info.title: reluai.cloud API
info.description:
Backend for [reluai.cloud](https://reluai.cloud) — portfolio demonstrations running on a
2-vCPU / 8 GB VPS. All demos work without paid APIs.

post.description: Send a message. Limited to 3 per hour and 6 per day per visitor.

get.description: Dashboard tiles: last run, last success, totals, recent trend and queue state.
Measured results per drop (latest successful run of each), for the project page.

schema.title: Response Get Runs Api Pipeline Runs Get

post.description: Queue a pipeline run. Limited per visitor and by overall queue capacity.

schema.title: Response Get Scenarios Api Pipeline Scenarios Get
Response Get Drops Api Pipeline Drops Get

get.description: Every reason code the validator can assign, with its explanation.

schema.title: Response Get Reasons Api Pipeline Reasons Get

get.description: The bundled real retailer table: columns, profile and data-quality findings.

post.description: Profile an uploaded CSV. It is stored for one hour and its contents are never logged.
Interpret a question (rules first, then an optional LLM tool call) and answer it.

get.description: The latest run of the fixed question sets (development and held-out).
How visitors' questions were handled over the last 30 days (no question text kept).

allow_llm.title: Allow Llm
allow_llm.description: Uploads only: allow sending the column names and types (never the rows) to an LLM provider if the rules cannot interpret the question.

file.title: File
file.description: CSV file, up to 2 MB and 50,000 rows

llm_available.title: Llm Available
llm_available.description: Whether a language model is configured to read questions the rules cannot

accuracy.title: Accuracy
accuracy.description: Correct plans among questions the rules should answer

value.title: Value
value.description: Comparison value. A list for 'in'/'not_in', [low, high] for 'between' (dates as 'YYYY-MM-DD'), omitted for 'is_null'/'not_null'.

column.title: Column
column.description: Column to aggregate. Omit only for agg='count' (count of rows).

time_bucket.description: Group a date column by day/week/month/quarter/year

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: metric_* orders by the first metric; group_* by the groups/time

QueryPlan.title: QueryPlan
QueryPlan.description: Aggregate query over one table: metrics, optionally grouped and filtered.

label.title: Label
label.description: Heading for the column, e.g. 'Total revenue'

ResultsOut.title: ResultsOut
ResultsOut.description: Measured results: the latest successful run of every loaded drop.

dq_formula.title: Dq Formula
dq_formula.default: 100 × Σ(weight × passed) / Σ(weight); weights: gate 3, warn 2, info 1

UsageOut.title: UsageOut
UsageOut.description: Last 30 days of visitor questions, from the outcome log.
